title: Repeat a message
prompt: Write `say`, which takes a message and prints it. In `run`, call say with "Scanning" and then with "Clear", so the output is those two words.
hints: Parameters can carry text as well as numbers.
`func say(message):` with `print(message)`, then two calls with the two strings.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
